userCardText: DID Space user scope (/user) `/user` is a CALLER-SCOPED projection of this blocklet's user fragment, not a directory in the app tree: for the caller did:key:z… it is the same directory as /blocklets/arcblog/users/z…/arcblog/ (measured, REQ-028). It needs NO blocklet.yaml declaration — the session authorizes it. A signed-out visitor has no /user view at all (404 AFS_NOT_FOUND), and a different DID resolves the same path to its own, different directory. `arc afs` cannot address /user (no AUP session → `No module found for path`) — use the page, or address the fragment by DID. Print the AFS path of an app DID Space fragment arc space path did:blocklet:arcblog --scope user File counts per role for this instance's app spaces arc space list --scope user Reading-list CLI (records addressed by reader DID) node scripts/arcblog-bookmarks.mjs list --user <did> Preview a mirror export (writes nothing) arc space sync --
